changes: Find joined shared calendars in Invites, with coloured cards and shortcuts to view, invite people, or change calendar settings.
Event invitations are grouped by calendar, and calendar invitations contribute to the Invites badge. Search also finds calendar names.
New shared calendars start with a contrasting, least-used colour. Existing colours stay unchanged and shared calendars stand out in the calendar drawer.
Invites explains when shared-calendar access needs to be enabled separately for the current login session.
